title: Jesus... Why Does My Best Friend Have A New Life Without Me?
topic: best friend moved abroad and they are drifting apart

bible.text: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for a time of adversity.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why does it feel like my best friend has a whole new life without me?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: She moved to Canada in June. Now she takes two days to reply, and her stories are full of people I don't know.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You miss her. That's not jealousy. It means the friendship was real.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But I'm still here doing the same things. It's like I got left behind.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Distance changes the rhythm, not always the love. She might be lonely in a crowd you can't see.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why do I always have to be the one who texts first? 😔

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You don't have to keep score. Send the voice note anyway. And let Me fill the evenings she can't.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Real friendship can stretch across a time zone. Give it room to breathe.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Who's the friend you need to send a voice note to today? 🙏
